test_GameController_move_to: test the GameController.move_to method to move the player to target coordinates with optional speed limit
test_GameController_rotate: test the GameController.rotate method to rotate the player by a delta angle in the horizontal plane
test_GameController_stop: test the GameController.stop method to stop the player as soon as possible with velocity tolerance
test_GameController_jump: test the GameController.jump method to make the player jump and then stop
test_GameController_look_at_2d: test the GameController.look_at_2d method to rotate the player towards a target orientation angle
